concerns.text: The plan states it will “download a verified open dataset (RBF‑Morph “doe.csv”)” and proceeds to model the relationship between processing parameters and mechanical properties. However, the RBF‑Morph dataset only provides three generic numeric predictors (x1, x2, x3) and a generic response column, none of which correspond to the required AM‑specific variables (laser power, scan speed, layer thickness, yield strength, ductility) defined in FR‑001. Using this proxy dataset does not satisfy the functional requirement to study AM alloy process‑property correlations, making the dataset inappropriate for the research question.
